name: eki-ecosystem
description: University bus tracking with authenticated HTTPS GNSS telemetry, resilient ordered trip state, and a Next.js frontend.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs && node scripts/update-csp.mjs && node scripts/verify-web-backend-contract.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run lint --workspace=backend
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run verify:openapi && npm run verify:ui-contracts && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev --omit=optional
scripts.qa:check: node scripts/qa/safety-preflight.mjs && node scripts/qa/acceptance-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/qa/workflow-policy.mjs
scripts.qa:nightly: npm run qa:check && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs gnss && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs reviewedUnit && npm run build --workspace=backend && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs emulator && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs browser && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs api && node scripts/qa/campaign.mjs native && node scripts/qa/campaign-report.mjs
scripts.qa:weekly: npm run qa:check && npm run qa:mutation && npm run qa:soak
